```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(argos)
library(srcr)

source('../code/cohort_fot_anom.R')
ndq_session<-argos$new('ndq_session')$init_session(
  db_src = Sys.getenv('PEDSNET_BASE_CONFIG'),
  base_dir = Sys.getenv('NDQ_ROOT'),
  results_schema = 'dqa_rox', 
  retain_intermediates = FALSE,
  db_trace = FALSE, 
  results_name_tag = ''
)
set_argos_default(ndq_session)
```

```{r}
rslt_fot_tbl<-results_tbl('fot_anom_tst')%>%collect()
sites<-rslt_fot_tbl%>%arrange(site)%>%distinct(site)%>%pull()
checks<-rslt_fot_tbl%>%distinct(check_name)%>%pull()
rslt_plt<-list()
for(i in 1:length(checks)){
  for(k in 1:length(sites)){
  dat_to_plot<-rslt_fot_tbl%>%filter(site==sites[k],
                                     check_name==checks[i])
  print(plot_fot_anom(dat_to_plot))
  }
  k<-0
}
```
